_comment: 1.9 Festival Days: one every 7 days (a Sunday), the four in turn. One mini-game each, best of any number of tries counts, prizes are paid once when the player collects. stars needs [1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars] scores. See BALANCE.md > Festivals.

spring.name: Egg Hunt
spring.blurb: Hazel has hidden eggs all over the square. Find as many as you can before the bell rings!
spring.rules: Tap the bushes to look for eggs. 8 eggs are hiding among 20 bushes, and you have 40 seconds.

summer.name: Fishing Derby
summer.blurb: Marlow and the village are fishing off the square pier. Biggest catch wins!
summer.rules: Five casts. Tap when the marker is in the green to cast far and land a big fish.

autumn.name: Harvest Fair
autumn.blurb: The villagers judge the best crop and the best good in the valley. Silver and gold stars score more!
autumn.rules: Pick one crop and one good from your barn to show. They come back to the barn afterwards.

winter.name: Feast of Lights
winter.blurb: The whole village shares a feast by lantern light. The more different dishes on the table, the happier everyone is.
winter.rules: Bring up to 6 different dishes from your barn. Each one is eaten, and every villager remembers who brought their favourite.
